name: GaussianShader Material Model
definition: Enhances 3DGS by incorporating trainable material parameters: diffuse dp, specular sp, roughness ρp, and normal np, along with a global environment map.
summary: GaussianShader enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting by binding trainable material parameters to kernels for physically-based rendering, enabling accurate specular reflections that standard opacity-based splatting cannot capture.
